description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Map Operations Manager' (MapOM) class, which manages operations for the orchestrator component in the Android Cuttlefish project. It tests creation, retrieval, completion, waiting, and listing of operations, focusing on their state transitions and concurrency handling.

methods.name: TestMapOMNewOperation
methods.description: Tests creation of a new operation and checks if its name is non-empty and the 'Done' flag is false.

methods.name: TestMapOMNewOperationNoNewUniqueUUIDsPanic
methods.description: Ensures that creating new operations with a duplicate UUID factory causes a panic.

methods.name: TestMapOMGetOperation
methods.description: Verifies retrieving an existing operation returns the correct data, and retrieving a non-existent one yields an error.

methods.name: TestMapOMCompleteOperation
methods.description: Checks completing an existing operation and that the 'Done' flag is set, and that completing a non-existent operation returns an error.

methods.name: TestMapOMWaitOperation
methods.description: Tests waiting for operation completion, ensuring success when completed, timeout behavior when not, and error when operation does not exist.

methods.name: TestMapOMGetOperationResult
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of operation results for non-existent, in-progress, and completed states.

methods.name: TestMapOMListRunningEmpty
methods.description: Checks that listing running operations returns an empty list when none are running.

methods.name: TestMapOMListRunning
methods.description: Verifies listing of currently running operations, ensuring correct operation inclusion and order.
